summary: Verified Careers banner centering fix on /welcome page. The fix (shouldCenterCareersBanner = true) now correctly centers the banner content across ALL viewport widths including the user's reported 1600px wide desktop. All 8 tested viewports (390, 768, 1180, 1365, 1440, 1479, 1600, 1920) show body center delta of 0px with perfectly balanced left/right spacing. No horizontal overflow detected at any width.
